replacement.title: Mobile Pricing Panel Frame Fit
replacement.definition: Keep the pricing panels fully within the mobile viewport without extending outside the page frame.

patches.decision_note: Mobile pricing-panel overflow is an independently testable responsive behavior and does not belong to the YouTube-icon Requirement.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer claims that the hero video is working after the reported playback failure.

patches.decision_note: The target is clear, but the freelancer reports working status without describing an executed test or concrete observed playback result.
The supplied evidence does not safely resolve whether the late revisions, including the secondary course-content controls, apply to both page variants or only one variant.
